# robots.txt — GENERATED by tools/build-robots.py. Do not hand-edit.
#
# Every group below repeats the same Disallow list, deliberately. robots.txt
# groups are not combined: a crawler with its own named group ignores the
# global "*" group completely. A rule that appears only under "*" does not
# apply to any named crawler.

User-agent: *
# Talent privacy. names.json is the only published file holding a talent's
# real name, and it exists so a visitor's browser can paint names onto the
# roster. No crawler may read it. _data/ holds the source roster.
# Talent contact details exist nowhere on this site at all.
Disallow: /talents/names.json
Disallow: /_data/
# Internal client review and photo-selection pages.
Disallow: /contact-sheet.html
Disallow: /cs-couple.html
Disallow: /cs-rukmini.html
Disallow: /cs-wedding.html
Disallow: /ruk-choose.html
Disallow: /review.html
# Unfinished previews and scratch pages — not for indexing.
Disallow: /_hero-preview.html
Disallow: /hero-motion-preview.html
Disallow: /work-preview.html
Disallow: /_fonts-preview.html
Disallow: /edit.html
Disallow: /studio.html
Disallow: /labs.html
Disallow: /yks-productions-onepage.html
Allow: /
